annotations.title: Save an email-reading rule (hack) to a track

description: Saves a hack and attaches it to a track, so matching messages become rows from now on. Give hackId to change one that exists. mapping says which hack field fills which column, as {"column_key": {"kind": "field", "key": "hack_field"}} or {"kind": "const", "value": "..."}; leave it out to match fields to columns by name. Set senders so only those senders' messages are read, and subjects when a sender also sends other mail (statements, offers) that isn't for this hack.

hackId.description: The hack to change, from list_tracks. Leave out for a new one.

mapping.description: Column key to source, as in the description.

subjects.description: Optional, with senders: read only their emails whose subject contains one of these words (any case), like ["Transaction alert"]. Their other emails are left out, not put in the Inbox. An email that fits the template is read whatever its subject, so no row is lost if the subject changes. Leave out to keep what the hack has; an empty list reads every subject.

name: save_hack
title: Save an email-reading rule (hack) to a track
